purpose: Measure the frozen core against the ONE same-model published number this study can reach on any carrier: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct's 9.79 zero-shot WER on the ESB 'Earnings22' test subset. One cell, E22-ESB-2735: every one of the 2,735 published test utterances, cut locally from the six locked earnings22-original MP3s at the published segment boundaries, one utterance per contact, raw audio through the resident bf16 mmproj, greedy, build 04ccc72a. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-04-e22-esb-shortform-alignment-v1-preregistration.md.

predecessor.result: ALIGNED, corpus Whisper-normalized WER 8.200 over all 44 Earnings-21 discovery calls
predecessor.what_it_supplies_here: the instruction, the decoding params, the audio path, the build, the hardened server env and the geometry rule -- everything except the corpus and the segmentation

primary.source: NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel, 'Fine-Tune Qwen3-Omni for ASR'
primary.protocol: Whisper EnglishTextNormalizer both sides, greedy, N = 2741 utterances
primary.note: the ONLY same-model published number across this study's three carriers

cross_read.system: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on the Open ASR Leaderboard English subset

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory

shared_protocol.instruction: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.
shared_protocol.instruction_provenance: byte-identical to the instruction SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 sent, itself byte-identical to the sealed 2026-08-14 fixed-batch-zero-locked-buf90 fragment

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 2,735 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 2,743; the registered exposure ceiling is 2,800
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 19,494.608437 s for one pass, rounded up to 19,500; the registered exposure ceiling is 20,500, about 5 % above the pass
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 1.5; the registered ceiling is 2.0. The full-44 flight served 1,593 windows of 90 s each in 0.973 GPU-h at -np 6 with graphs disabled, i.e. 143,370 s of audio; this cell is 19,495 s of audio in 2,735 far shorter requests at -np 8, so the encode side is about 7x smaller and the decode side is bounded by 2,735 completions the full-44 flight's own evidence puts at a few hundred tokens each. 1.5 h is deliberately generous against that.
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values. core/model/adapter.py meters the plan CUMULATIVELY across every attempt of a run id, so a partly spent dead attempt takes a fresh run id and a fresh row.

decision.owner_alignment_standard: 2026-09-04 owner directive: aligned means within 3 points of the published number, or better by more than 3; and the frozen Qwen3-Omni Q4_K_M must never score worse than a degraded (smaller / older / more quantized) model's published number on the same column.
decision.floor_test_loose: corpus Whisper-normalized WER <= 15.09 (whisper-base.en), reported either way
decision.aligned: ALIGNED = band test AND strict floor test both pass
decision.fail: NOT ALIGNED otherwise, with the failing half of the rule named and the gap decomposed per call, plus the segmentation / quantization / serving decomposition
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim. This is a one-time owner-authorized calibration read of six calls that become calibration-exposed afterwards; no knob is tuned on them and no mechanism arm is flown.
decision.not_authorized: No mechanism arm. No read of the other 109 confirmatory calls. No ESB validation-split read. No Q8_0 cell. No fine-tuning comparison. No fstalign. No paper-scale work.

owner_decision_2026_09_04: Owner decision 2026-09-04 (evening): the six ESB test calls 4432298, 4450488, 4470290, 4479741, 4483338, 4485244, all in the study's Earnings-22 confirmatory split, may be read ONCE for this direct-baseline calibration; they are re-designated calibration-exposed afterwards; 109 confirmatory calls remain for final reporting. No mechanism arm, no knob tuned, no other confirmatory call read.

companion_run.why_separate: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, so a 4-row smoke and a 2,735-row flight cannot share a run id. They share one preregistration, one harness, one entry point and one verdict.
